svg.title: What I’m exploring now
svg.desc: changelog.md: Day 0, seed 0 planted. Day 13, small sprout. Day 16, first green leaf. Day 30, the sapling takes shape. Day 60, a full canopy. Day 90, first tangerine ripens. A binary tangerine tree grows digit by digit beside it, with tiny binary tangerines and blossoms in a multicolor canopy. Kirby hops on the changelog window, and Don Quixote bobs on the Canopy window.
